retrieval_sources.source_definition: exact frozen #143 R1/R2/R3 source_specs: 1 R1 seed-topic source + 35 R2 text-query sources + 15 R3 anchor-query sources
retrieval_sources.union_semantics: deduplicated union of all 51 frozen sources

exact_merge_principle.name: top-L per-source sufficiency under a static provider state; first-observation freeze under live citation drift
exact_merge_principle.statement: For a union U of source sets S_i under one common total ranking, every element in the top L of U is contained in the top L of at least one S_i to which it belongs. Therefore unioning source-local top-L prefixes and re-ranking is sufficient for the global top-L under a static provider state. Complete source-local citation-boundary tie closure preserves the declared citation-count then Work-ID ordering when provider tie order is unspecified.
exact_merge_principle.live_provider_caveat: OpenAlex is live rather than snapshot-backed. When a duplicate Work ID is observed with different cited_by_count values across durable source transactions, preserve every observation and freeze that Work's ranking score to its earliest source transaction observation (transaction_started_at, then source_id tie-break). Do not silently claim a single-provider-snapshot exact union for an era with observed citation drift.

ranking_surface.duplicate_work_id_policy: DEDUP_BY_WORK_ID; CITATION DRIFT -> FREEZE EARLIEST SOURCE-TRANSACTION OBSERVATION AND PRESERVE ALL OBSERVATIONS
ranking_surface.live_duplicate_citation_resolution: earliest transaction_started_at, then source_id ascending; later duplicate observations never overwrite the frozen ranking score

candidate_ladder.source_prefix_rows: for each of 51 sources, retrieve source-local top L rows where L = 5 * k_d, plus complete citation tie at that source boundary
candidate_ladder.global_freeze: union frozen source-local prefixes, deduplicate by Work ID, freeze each Work's citation score at its earliest observed source transaction, canonical-sort, and retain all rows at or above the global L-th frozen citation count
candidate_ladder.expansion_if_exhausted_after_screening: versioned pre-decomposition expansion allowed only from eligibility/source-access attrition; never from decomposition outcomes

matching_order: normalized DOI exact match when both candidate and seed DOI exist
normalized title plus publication year exact match

top50_match_order: normalized DOI exact match when available
normalized title plus publication year only when title is present
optional_bibliographic_metadata_policy.optional_string_normalization: display_name/title and type are retained only when non-empty strings; null, blank, and non-string provider values normalize to null
optional_bibliographic_metadata_policy.duplicate_optional_field_policy: title and doi: coalesce null/non-null and fail closed on conflicting non-null values; type: preserve all observations and freeze earliest non-null source-transaction observation
optional_bibliographic_metadata_policy.duplicate_required_field_policy: year mismatch fails closed; cited_by_count drift is preserved and resolved only by the frozen earliest-observation policy
optional_bibliographic_metadata_policy.type_drift_role: descriptive metadata only; type is not a ranking key and is not used for Top50 calibration identity
optional_bibliographic_metadata_policy.type_drift_resolution: sort observations by transaction_started_at then source_id; select earliest non-null type; preserve all observations and distinct non-null values

execution_protocol.granularity: one frozen source prefix per provider transaction, then local-only era merge
execution_protocol.source_artifact_persistence: atomic JSON write after each successful source
execution_protocol.failed_source_policy: stop era immediately; do not retry failed source; preserve earlier successful source artifacts
execution_protocol.rate_limit_authentication: api_key query parameter, identical to ranking client
execution_protocol.credit_unit_authority: OpenAlex list/filter request consumes 1 credit; search consumes 10 credits; this ranking path is list/filter OQL
execution_protocol.provider_429_policy: fail current source transaction with no automatic retry; preserve earlier artifacts; resume only under a new versioned authorization after keyed rate-limit preflight
execution_protocol.live_duplicate_citation_drift_policy: provider-free merge only; preserve all duplicate citation observations, freeze earliest observation for ranking, report drift count/range, and downgrade snapshot exactness classification
execution_protocol.live_duplicate_optional_type_drift_polic: provider-free merge only; type conflicts do not affect ranking or calibration identity, are preserved in an observation ledger, and set single_provider_snapshot_claimed=false
